awk: line 2: function strtonum never defined

observation.command:
echo "=== who listens on 3000 ==="; cat /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {split($2,a,":"); port=strtonum("0x"a[2]); if(port==3000) print "local_ip="$2" inode="$10}'; 
# map inode to pid
for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do
  lsof_pid=$(ls -l /proc/$pid/fd 2>/dev/null | grep -c socket)
done
echo "=== try lsof ==="; command -v lsof && lsof -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P 2>/dev/null | head
echo "=== all node/vite pids + cwd ==="
for pid in $(pgrep -x node 2>/dev/null); do
  cwd=$(readlink /proc/$pid/cwd 2>/dev/null)
  ppid=$(awk '{print $4}' /proc/$pid/stat 2>/dev/null)
  echo "pid=$pid ppid=$ppid cwd=$cwd"
done
